1. **Frontend sender:** `postOrder` in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts:202-209`. It POSTs the `OrderPost` body to `${restBaseUrl}/order` via `openmrsFetch`.
2. **REST handler:** `save(Order)` in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_10/OrderResource1_10.java:326-329`. It calls `Context.getOrderService().saveOrder(delegate, null)`. The base implementation in `openmrs1_8/OrderResource1_8.java:72-75` is identical. `OrderResource2_2` extends `OrderResource1_10` and does not override `save`, so it inherits this method.
3. **Core service:** `OrderServiceImpl.saveOrder(Order, OrderContext)` at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/OrderServiceImpl.java:114-117`. It delegates to the private `saveOrder(order, ctx, false)` at lines 165-379. That method runs validation (`failOnExistingOrder`, `ensureDateActivatedIsSet`, `ensureConceptIsSet`, and others) and then calls `dao.saveOrder(order)` at line 378.
4. **Data access:** `HibernateOrderDAO.saveOrder(Order)` at `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateOrderDAO.java:92-95`. It calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate(sessionFactory.getCurrentSession(), order)`, which is the actual database write.
